Getting started with Zoom Notes

Category: Getting started and setting up

How to create a new note

Creating a note during a meeting
  1. Start a meeting from the Zoom desktop client.
  2. On the in-meeting controls, click the Notes button .
  3. At the top right, click New.
Creating a note in the Zoom desktop client
  1. Sign in to the Zoom desktop client.
  2. Click the Notes button .
  3. At the top right, click + New to create a new note.
Creating a note in the Zoom web portal
  1. Sign in to the Zoom web portal.
  2. Click Notes.
  3. At the top right, click + New to create a new note.

How to use the Notes tools

When editing a note, the editing tools are located at the top of the document window. These tools include text formatting and image insertion.

Available formatting tools
  • Text color: Changes the text color for the selected text.
  • Font: Changes the font style for the selected text.
  • Font size: Changes the font size for the selected text.
  • Bold icon : Bold the selected text.
  • Italicize: Italicize the selected text.
  • Underline icon: Underline the selected text.
  • Strikethrough icon : Strikethrough the selected text.
  • Highlight icon : Highlights the selected text in the selected color.
  • Link icon : Adds a hyperlink to the selected text.
  • Heading: Assigns a heading size to the selected text.
  • Text align: Allows users to change the alignment of the text.
  • List icon : Allows the creation of an Ordered list, Bulleted list, or Checklist.
  • Decrease indentation icon : Decreases the line indentation for the selected text.
  • Increase indentation icon : Increases the line indentation for the selected text.
  • Insert image icon : Inserts an image into the note.
  • Clear Style icon : Clears all applied styling and reverts text to the default style.
Keyboard shortcuts available for Notes

Use the following keyboard shortcuts and controls to activate actions in notes. These shortcuts can also be found by clicking Help in Notes menu.

For other keyboard shortcuts available on the Zoom desktop client and mobile app, refer to the hot keys and keyboard shortcuts article.

macOS
General
  • Command(⌘)+X: Cut selected text.
  • Command(⌘)+C: Copy selected text.
  • Command(⌘)+V: Paste copied or cut text.
  • Command(⌘)+A: Select all text in the note.
Edit
  • Command(⌘)+Z: Undo text change.
  • Command(⌘)+Y or Command(⌘)+Shift+Z: Redo undone text changes.
Text
  • Command(⌘)+B: Bold text.
  • Command(⌘)+I: Italicize text.
  • Command(⌘)+U: Underline text.
  • Command(⌘)+K: Add a hyperlink to the selected text.
Other
  • Command(⌘)+R: Reload a note.
  • Command(⌘)+F: Find text within a note.
Windows | Linux
General
  • Ctrl+X: Cut selected text.
  • Ctrl+C: Copy selected text.
  • Ctrl+V: Paste copied or cut text.
  • Ctrl+A: Select all text in the note.
Edit
  • Ctrl+Z: Undo text change.
  • Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z: Redo undone text changes.
Text
  • Ctrl+B: Bold text.
  • Ctrl+I: Italicize text.
  • Ctrl+U: Underline text.
  • Ctrl+K: Add a hyperlink to the selected text.
Other
  • Ctrl+R: Reload a note.
  • Ctrl+F: Find text within a note.

How to rename a note

  1. Create or open a note.
  2. At the top left of the note page, click the note title to rename it. The new display name will take effect immediately.

Note: To edit the name of a note, you need to have owner or co-owner access.

How to share a note

  1. Create or open a note.
  2. At the top right of the notes page, click Share.
  3. Enter the email address or name of the contact, or the channel you would like to share the note with, and set their permissions.
  4. (Optional) Under Invite Message, enter a message that will be sent to the collaborators.
  5. Click Share Note.

Learn more about sharing a note inside and outside of Zoom meetings.

How to delete a note

  1. Open a note.
  2. At the top right of the note page, click the More button .
  3. Select Move to Trash.

Learn more about deleting and recovering a note.

How to manage notes

Notes that you have created, as well as notes shared with you, can be managed from the Notes Dashboard within the Zoom Desktop client or from the Zoom Web Portal. From the Notes Dashboard, notes can be edited, deleted, shared, duplicated, starred, and/or locked, depending on your level of access or ownership of the note. In addition, the control permissions for the note can be modified as well.

Managing notes from the Notes Dashboard

Category: Product features > User features

How to manage notes while in a meeting

  • Windows | macOS | Linux
  1. Start a meeting from the Zoom desktop client.
  2. On the in-meeting controls, click the Notes button. The Notes dashboard will display.
  3. In the Notes menu, choose from the following options:
  • All Notes (All): Displays all notes visible to you.
  • Recent: Displays the notes you created or opened recently.
  • My Notes (My): Displays all notes you have created.
  • Shared with me (Shared): Displays all notes others have directly shared with you. Note: Notes shared via a Chat channel will not be displayed here.
  • Starred: Displays notes that have been starred.
  • Trash: Displays all deleted notes currently in the trash. Note: The Notes window may need to be resized for Trash to be displayed.
  1. In addition, you can utilize the search bar within each tab, and filter options in the top left to also find the desired note.
  2. Once you found the desired note, you can open the note or click the More button for additional options, including:
  • Share: Allows you to share the note with participants in the meeting or other collaborators.
  • Lock: Temporarily prevents editors and viewers from opening and editing a note, while owners and co-owners retain full editing functionality.
  • Add to Starred: Add the note to the Starred tab in the Notes dashboard.
  • Rename: Update the name of the note.
  • Duplicate: Creates a copy of the current note.
  • View activity: Displays the change history for the note.
  • Move to Trash: Deletes the note and moves it to the trash.

How to create a new note during a Zoom meeting

How to edit a note during a Zoom meeting

How to share a note during a Zoom meeting

Sharing a note with participants in a meeting
  1. Start a meeting from the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the meeting controls toolbar, click the Notes button.
  3. At the top right, click New or click an existing note you would like to edit.
  4. Click the Share button.
  5. Under Share with Meeting collaborators, click Share to Meeting.
  6. In the next window, select the desired permissions for the participants:
  • Collaborating: Participants in the meeting will have edit access to the note.
  • Viewing: Participants in the meeting will have view-only access to the note.
  1. (Optional) Enable Allow persistent access to verified meeting participants after closing the document to allow participants access to the note after the note has been closed or the meeting ended. Note: Participants will need to be signed into a Zoom Account when joining the meeting to be given persistent access.
  2. Click Share Note.
Sharing a note with other collaborators while in a meeting
  1. Start a meeting from the Zoom desktop app.

  3. At the top right, click New or click an existing note you would like to edit.
  4. Click the Share button.
  5. Enter the name of a contact, email address, or the channel you would like to share the note with and set their permissions.
  6. (Optional) Under Invite Message, enter a message that will be sent to the new collaborators.

Zoom Scheduler

Using Webex with Zoom Scheduler

Category: Features

How to connect Webex

Connect your Webex account to Zoom Scheduler to automatically generate Webex meeting links for your bookings. Once connected, Scheduler will use your Webex account to create meeting links when attendees book time with you.

  1. Sign in to Zoom Scheduler.
  2. In the left navigation, click Integrations.
  3. Find the Webex card and click Connect. A Webex sign-in window will open.
  4. Sign in with the Webex account you want to use and grant Scheduler the requested permissions. The Webex card will update to show your account as connected.

Notes:

  • Only one Webex account can be connected at a time. To switch accounts, disconnect the existing one first, then connect the new account.
  • Disconnecting will prevent future bookings from using this service. Previously generated meeting links and booking records will be retained in accordance with Zoom’s data retention policies, as described in our Privacy Statement. To remove them, delete the associated scheduled events.

How to use Webex on a booking page

Once your Webex account is connected, you can set Webex as the meeting location on any booking page.

  1. Sign in to Zoom Scheduler.
  2. In the left navigation, click Booking Pages, then open the booking page you want to update or create a new one.
  3. In the booking page settings, click the Hosts tab and then scroll down to the How you’ll meet section.
  4. Select Webex.
  5. Click Finish to save your booking page. Every booking made on that page will automatically include a Webex meeting link in the confirmation email and calendar invite.

Notes:

  • Invitees don’t need a Webex account to join. Webex meeting links can be joined as a guest from a supported browser.
  • Each booking page has its own video conferencing setting. You can use Webex on some booking pages and Zoom on others, mix and match providers across your booking pages as needed.

How to disconnect Webex

Disconnect your Webex account from Zoom Scheduler if you no longer want to use it as a meeting location provider for your bookings.

  1. Sign in to Zoom Scheduler.
  2. In the left navigation, click Integrations.
  3. Find the Webex card and click Disconnect. Disconnecting Webex will affect any booking pages set to use it as the meeting location. Those pages will stop generating Webex links until you reconnect or select a different provider.

How to reconnect your Webex account

If your Webex connection is lost, for example, because you changed your password or revoked Scheduler’s permissions, Zoom Scheduler will no longer be able to generate Webex links for new bookings. You’ll need to reconnect to restore access.

  1. Sign in to Zoom Scheduler.
  2. In the left navigation, click Integrations.
  3. Find the Webex card and click Reconnect.
  4. Sign in to your Webex account again to restore the connection.

How to remove Webex from Zoom App Marketplace

To fully revoke Zoom Scheduler’s access to your Webex account, you can remove the app from the Zoom App Marketplace:

  1. Sign in to the Zoom App Marketplace.
  2. In the top-right corner, click Manage.
  3. In the left navigation, click Added Apps.
  4. Find the Webex app and click Remove.
  5. (Optional) Select a reason for removal, then click Remove.

Integration availability disclaimer

This integration relies on APIs provided by Webex. Zoom reserves the right to modify or discontinue this integration if third-party API access is restricted, modified, or terminated.

Third-party service disclaimer

Zoom provides these integrations to facilitate your use of third-party video conferencing services. Zoom is not responsible for the availability, performance, security, or data handling practices of Webex. Your use of these third-party services is governed by their respective terms of service and privacy policies.

How your data is used

The Webex integration allows Zoom Communications Inc., to access your Webex account and manage meetings on your behalf. The following permissions are required:

  • Schedule, update, and delete Webex meetings: Gives Zoom Communications Inc., approved access to create a Webex meeting link when someone books a time with you, and to remove that link if the booking is cancelled or rescheduled.
  • View your Webex profile: Zoom Communications Inc., will have permission to access your Webex profile information, including your display name and email address, to identify and display the connected account.

By allowing this connection, Zoom Scheduler will receive ongoing access to your Webex account to perform these actions on your behalf. By adding this connection, you agree to the Zoom Privacy Statement and the Webex Terms of Service.

Creating a One to Many booking schedule

Category: Getting started and setting up > User guide

How to access Zoom Scheduler

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web

  1. Sign in to the Zoom desktop app.

  2. Click More , then click the Scheduler icon.

  3. Sign in to the Zoom web portal.

  4. In the left navigation menu, click Scheduler.

How to create One to Many schedules

Creating a booking schedule allows your clients to view your availability and schedule a time that suits you both. You can create recurring time schedules, which repeat until a specific date or can repeat forever. Additionally, your booking page photo and name match your current Zoom profile picture and name.

Recurring booking schedules and custom booking schedules will create a booking link, which is shared with others by the organizer. Recurring booking links can also be accessed through the organizer’s public page. While the links to recurring booking schedules are always active (as long as the host has that booking schedule active), links for custom schedules will expire after the date of the scheduled time slot(s) and no longer be accessible to those you shared it with.

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web
Create a One to Many booking schedule
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the left navigation menu, click Booking pages, then click Create booking pages. A pop-up window will appear.
  3. In the window, select the One to Many schedule type. Note: Only repeating availabilities appear on your public page. This will schedule a meeting with multiple attendees and you as the host. The full attendee list will not be visible on the calendar invite.
  4. Click Next to continue to the next page.
  5. Under the Details tab, provide the following information:
  • Booking Page Name: Choose the default name used for each created calendar event.
  • Schedule Color: Select a color. This is used to color-code scheduled events on your personal dashboard. Invitees visiting your Scheduler page will also see the event type color.
  • Booking Page Link: Add a custom subdomain. Note: The public page link must contain at least 3 characters and not contain non-alphanumeric characters, except for - and _.
  • Duration: Choose the default duration of the calendar events created.
  • How you’ll meet: Choose between Zoom Meeting, Phone call, In-person or Custom location. Note: This will be shown as the meeting location in the calendar.
  • Max Attendees: Choose how many attendees can sign up to join this session.
  • Show available attendee seats on booking page: When enabled, each available time slot will display how many seats for this session are available.
  • Additional Options:
  • Hide from public booking page
  • Require verification code to book
  • (Optional) Description: Text will be displayed on your attendee booking page.
  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. Under the Choose Availability dropdown, select one of the following:
  • Set custom hours: In the list, select the checkboxes for the weekdays and specify the hours of availability.
  • (Optional) To apply the set hours of availability to every day of the booking schedule:
  1. To the right of the set of hours for availability, click the Apply hours to icon . A list of the weekdays will appear.
  2. In the list, select the checkboxes of the weekdays that you want to copy the set hours of availability.
  3. Click Apply. To select all weekdays and apply the set of hours for availability to all the days of a booking schedule, click Apply to all. The weekdays will be updated with the set of hours for availability. Note: Multiple time frames for each day can be created, which allows you to create a break for lunch or other existing meetings.
  • Use existing availability: The Working hours option will be set as the default. By default, Saturday and Sunday are disabled, while Monday through Friday are enabled and set to 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
  1. Under Timezone, choose which timezone this bookable time schedule will use. Your profile’s timezone is chosen by default. Note: When booking, users, who are in a different time zone from the organizer, can select the time zone that matches their current geographic locations.
  2. The Date Overrides option will allow you to add a date and time. Note: The Date Overrides option will only appear when you select Set custom hours under Choose Availability.
  3. (Optional) Ignore calendar availability: Calendar events will not block the time slot from being offered to attendees; however, appointments scheduled through Zoom Scheduler will still block the time.
  4. Under Repeats, choose how many weeks you want this bookable schedule to be created for:
  • Forever: Keep this bookable schedule available with no end date. Note: Organizers can disable a bookable schedule as needed, without having to delete or edit it. This can be useful for suspending your availability while out of office.
  • Date Range: Choose to have this bookable schedule available and repeated each week until the date set.
  1. Under Buffer time between schedules, choose how much time to provide between back-to-back sessions. You can choose the buffer time for before and after meetings. This can be useful for giving yourself time to make notes or take follow-up actions, before potentially having another session scheduled.
  2. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  3. On the Notifications tab, manage your notifications:
  • Under System Notifications, edit your system notification type:
  • Email confirmation:
  • Booking Confirmation Email: This is sent immediately after a user books. Click Edit to edit the Booking Confirmation Email.
  • Cancellation Email: This is sent immediately after an event is canceled. Click Edit to edit the Cancellation Email.
  • (Optional) Select the Use a no-reply email address checkbox to hide your email address by having Zoom send email invites to attendees rather than from your own email address.
  • Reminders: Click the toggle to enable or disable the following notifications.
  • Reminder Email: Edit/Send reminder email.
  • Reminder SMS: Edit/Send reminder SMS.
  • Follow Up Email: Edit/Send follow up email.
  • Under Additional Notifications, choose the SMS and email notifications you want to apply to this booking schedule. Click the toggle to enable or disable the following additional notifications:
  • Before Event:
  • Booking Confirmation SMS: Sent immediately after a user books.
  • Cancellation SMS: Sent immediately after a user cancels.
  • Reconfirmation Email & SMS: Sent 2 days before the scheduled date, this email is sent to reconfirm a scheduled event.
  • Reminder Email & SMS: Sent 1 day before the scheduled date, this email is sent to remind the person who scheduled the event.
  • After Event:
  • Thank You Email & SMS: Sent 30 minutes after the event ends, this email is sent to thank the person for attending.
  • Quick Survey Email & SMS: Sent 1 hour after the event ends, this email is sent to have the participant(s) who scheduled the event to respond to a survey.
  • Follow Up Email & SMS: Sent 1 day after the event ends, this email is sent to follow up with the person who scheduled the event.
  • Other:
  • Additional Resources Email: Sent immediately after the event ends, this email is sent to share additional resources with the participant(s).
  • (Optional) Under Cancellation Policy, use this optional setting to add a cancellation policy for your event. The text entered will appear in the email notification sent to your invitee.
  • (Optional) Select the Include cancel and reschedule links in notifications checkbox.
  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. On the More Options tab, choose from the following additional configuration options:
  • Rules:
  • Show schedules in increments of: Choose how frequent time slots in a given time range are generated. Time slots will overlap each other until a session is booked, then conflicting time slots will be removed.
  • Set maximum number of bookings: Limits the total number of appointments that can be booked for a specific time period or event.
  • Prevent last-minute bookings by setting a minimum notice period: This setting ensures that attendees provide a minimum notice period when booking appointments, helping you avoid last-minute scheduling.
  • Limit how far in advance attendees can book: This setting allows you to control the maximum number of days or weeks in advance that attendees can schedule appointments.
  • Lock this time zone for attendees: When enabled, attendees will view and book available time slots based on the selected time zone, regardless of their local time zone.
  • CC’ed attendees: This setting automatically forwards all calendar events created from this booking page to the specified email addresses. It is useful for inviting a team member as a backup to your appointments without granting them editing access to the booking page.
  • Confirmation Page: Customize your booking schedule confirmation page. You can also add a URL on your confirmation page to redirect attendees to another website with additional information.
  • Upon Confirmation: Click the dropdown and select if you want to Display Zoom Scheduler confirmation page or Redirect to external site for attendees.
  • (Optional) Click the Display button text to schedule another event checkbox. Then, enter the Button text.
  • Attendee Questions: Create custom fields in Q&A format. You can enable or disable the field, set the field as Required, choose to show the field on the scheduling page, and choose the Answer Format, and delete or add more fields.
  1. Click Finish to save this bookable schedule. When created, you will be provided with the link to this booking calendar, so that it can be shared with others.
  • (Optional) Click the Customize button to customise your booking link and Add pre-filled answers. This will add default answers to booking questions, so attendees see a pre-filled form when they open the link.

  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. Under the Choose Availability dropdown, select one of the following:
  • Set custom hours: In the list, select the checkboxes for the weekdays and specify the hours of availability.
  • (Optional) To apply the set hours of availability to every day of the booking schedule:
  1. To the right of the set of hours for availability, click the Apply hours to icon . A list of the weekdays will appear.
  2. In the list, select the checkboxes of the weekdays that you want to copy the set hours of availability.
  3. Click Apply. To select all weekdays and apply the set of hours for availability to all the days of a booking schedule, click Apply to all. The weekdays will be updated with the set of hours for availability. Note: Multiple time frames for each day can be created, which allows you to create a break for lunch or other existing meetings.
  • Use existing availability: The Working hours option will be set as the default. By default, Saturday and Sunday are disabled, while Monday through Friday are enabled and set to 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
  1. Under Timezone, choose which timezone this bookable time schedule will use. Your profile’s timezone is chosen by default. Note: When booking, users, who are in a different time zone from the organizer, can select the time zone that matches their current geographic locations.
  2. The Date Overrides option will allow you to add a date and time. Note: The Date Overrides option will only appear when you select Set custom hours under Choose Availability.
  3. (Optional) Ignore calendar availability: Calendar events will not block the time slot from being offered to attendees; however, appointments scheduled through Zoom Scheduler will still block the time.
  4. Under Repeats, choose how many weeks you want this bookable schedule to be created for:
  • Forever: Keep this bookable schedule available with no end date. Note: Organizers can disable a bookable schedule as needed, without having to delete or edit it. This can be useful for suspending your availability while out of office.
  • Date Range: Choose to have this bookable schedule available and repeated each week until the date set.
  1. Under Buffer time between schedules, choose how much time to provide between back-to-back sessions. You can choose the buffer time for before and after meetings. This can be useful for giving yourself time to make notes or take follow-up actions, before potentially having another session scheduled.
  2. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  3. On the Notifications tab, manage your notifications:
  • Under System Notifications, edit your system notification type:
  • Email confirmation:
  • Booking Confirmation Email: This is sent immediately after a user books. Click Edit to edit the Booking Confirmation Email.
  • Cancellation Email: This is sent immediately after an event is canceled. Click Edit to edit the Cancellation Email.
  • (Optional) Select the Use a no-reply email address checkbox to hide your email address by having Zoom send email invites to attendees rather than from your own email address.
  • Reminders: Click the toggle to enable or disable the following notifications.
  • Reminder Email: Edit/Send reminder email.
  • Reminder SMS: Edit/Send reminder SMS.
  • Follow Up Email: Edit/Send follow up email.
  • Under Additional Notifications, choose the SMS and email notifications you want to apply to this booking schedule. Click the toggle to enable or disable the following additional notifications:
  • Before Event:
  • Booking Confirmation SMS: Sent immediately after a user books.
  • Cancellation SMS: Sent immediately after a user cancels.
  • Reconfirmation Email & SMS: Sent 2 days before the scheduled date, this email is sent to reconfirm a scheduled event.
  • Reminder Email & SMS: Sent 1 day before the scheduled date, this email is sent to remind the person who scheduled the event.
  • After Event:
  • Thank You Email & SMS: Sent 30 minutes after the event ends, this email is sent to thank the person for attending.
  • Quick Survey Email & SMS: Sent 1 hour after the event ends, this email is sent to have the participant(s) who scheduled the event to respond to a survey.
  • Follow Up Email & SMS: Sent 1 day after the event ends, this email is sent to follow up with the person who scheduled the event.
  • Other:
  • Additional Resources Email: Sent immediately after the event ends, this email is sent to share additional resources with the participant(s).
  • (Optional) Under Cancellation Policy, use this optional setting to add a cancellation policy for your event. The text entered will appear in the email notification sent to your invitee.
  • (Optional) Select the Include cancel and reschedule links in notifications checkbox.
  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. On the More Options tab, choose from the following additional configuration options:
  • Rules:
  • Show schedules in increments of: Choose how frequent time slots in a given time range are generated. Time slots will overlap each other until a session is booked, then conflicting time slots will be removed.
  • Set maximum number of bookings: Limits the total number of appointments that can be booked for a specific time period or event.
  • Prevent last-minute bookings by setting a minimum notice period: This setting ensures that attendees provide a minimum notice period when booking appointments, helping you avoid last-minute scheduling.
  • Limit how far in advance attendees can book: This setting allows you to control the maximum number of days or weeks in advance that attendees can schedule appointments.
  • Lock this time zone for attendees: When enabled, attendees will view and book available time slots based on the selected time zone, regardless of their local time zone.
  • CC’ed attendees: This setting automatically forwards all calendar events created from this booking page to the specified email addresses. It is useful for inviting a team member as a backup to your appointments without granting them editing access to the booking page.
  • Confirmation Page: Customize your booking schedule confirmation page. You can also add a URL on your confirmation page to redirect attendees to another website with additional information.
  • Upon Confirmation: Click the dropdown and select if you want to Display Zoom Scheduler confirmation page or Redirect to external site for attendees.
  • (Optional) Click the Display button text to schedule another event checkbox. Then, enter the Button text.
  • Attendee Questions: Create custom fields in Q&A format. You can enable or disable the field, set the field as Required, choose to show the field on the scheduling page, and choose the Answer Format, and delete or add more fields.
  1. Click Finish to save this bookable schedule. When created, you will be provided with the link to this booking calendar, so that it can be shared with others.
  • (Optional) Click the Customize button to customise your booking link and Add pre-filled answers. This will add default answers to booking questions, so attendees see a pre-filled form when they open the link.

Creating a One to One booking schedule

Category: Getting started and setting up > User guide

How to access Zoom Scheduler

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web

  1. Sign in to the Zoom desktop app.

  2. Click More , then click the Scheduler tab.

  3. Sign in to the Zoom web portal.

  4. In the left navigation menu, click Scheduler.

How to create One to One schedules

Creating a booking schedule allows your clients to view your availability and schedule a time that suits you both. You can create recurring time schedules, which repeat until a specific date or can repeat forever. Additionally, your booking page photo and name match your current Zoom profile picture and name.

Recurring booking schedules and custom booking schedules will create a booking link, which is shared with others by the organizer. Recurring booking links can also be accessed through the organizer’s public page. While the links to recurring booking schedules are always active (as long as the host has that booking schedule active), links for custom schedules will expire after the date of the scheduled time slot(s) and no longer be accessible to those you shared it with.

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web
Create a One to One booking schedule
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. Click the Scheduler tab. Note: You may need to click the More button to locate the Scheduler tab.
  3. At the bottom of the page, click Create booking pages. A pop-up window will appear.
  4. In the window, select the One to One schedule type. Note: Only repeating availabilities appear on your public page. This will schedule a meeting with one attendee and you as the host. The attendee can add other guests when booking if the host allows.
  5. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  6. Under the Details tab, provide the following information:
  • Schedule Name: Choose the default name used for each created calendar event.
  • Schedule Color: Select a color. This is used to color-code scheduled events on your personal dashboard. Invitees visiting your Scheduler page will also see the event type color.
  • Schedule Link: Add a custom subdomain. Note: The public page link must contain at least 3 characters and not contain non-alphanumeric characters, except for - and _.
  • Duration: Choose the default duration of the calendar events created.
  • Video Conferencing: Choose which service to be used when creating a calendar event: None, Zoom Meeting, or Zoom Phone Only. Note: When a Zoom Meeting appointment is created, it will have the same default settings as the user’s Zoom Meetings default settings.
  • (Optional) If you chose Zoom Meeting, select the Enable Zoom Meeting Waiting Room checkbox to enable the Waiting Room feature. You can enable or disable the Waiting Room feature for Zoom Scheduler meeting appointments. The Waiting Room feature allows you to control when a participant joins the meeting. As the meeting host, you can admit participants one by one, or hold all participants in the waiting room and admit them all at once.
  • (Optional) Location: Provide details on where this meeting will take place, such as a room or address.
  • (Optional) Under Private Schedule, select the Make this a private schedule checkbox. When selected, only invitees who have this link can schedule with you. This schedule will not be visible on your public page.
  • (Optional) Additional Information: Provide additional text to be included with the calendar event. This is optional but can be used to provide important information to clients booking time with you ahead of their scheduled event, such as joining instructions, cancellation information, and more.
  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. On the Availability tab, choose which days of the week to make available for the bookings, as well as the time frame on each day. By default, Saturday and Sunday are disabled, while Monday through Friday are enabled and set to 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Note: Multiple time frames for each day can be created, which allows you to create a break for lunch or other existing meetings.
  • (Optional) To apply the set hours of availability to every day of the booking schedule:
  1. To the right of the set of hours for availability, click the Apply hours to icon . A list of the weekdays will appear.
  2. In the list, select the checkboxes of the weekdays that you want to copy the set hours of availability.
  3. Click Apply. To select all weekdays and apply the set of hours for availability to all the days of a booking schedule, click Apply to all. The weekdays will be updated with the set of hours for availability.
  4. Under Exclude specific dates, choose to exclude certain days from the booking schedule. Multiple dates can be selected. Additionally, restricted dates can be edited and deleted.
  5. Click + Add a date.
  6. Select the date(s) you want from the calendar. The dates will appear under Exclude specific dates.
  7. (Optional) On a date you want to remove, click the X button.
  8. Under Timezone, choose which timezone this bookable time schedule will use. Your profile’s timezone is chosen by default. Note: When booking, users, who are in a different time zone from the organizer, can select the time zone that matches their current geographic locations.
  9. Under Repeats, choose how many weeks you want this bookable schedule to be created for:
  • Forever: Keep this bookable schedule available with no end date. Note: Organizers can disable a bookable schedule as needed, without having to delete or edit it. This can be useful for suspending your availability while out of office.
  • Date Range: Choose to have this bookable schedule available and repeated each week until the date set.
  1. Under Buffer time between schedules, choose how much time to provide between back-to-back sessions. You can choose the buffer time for before and after meetings. This can be useful for giving yourself time to make notes or take follow-up actions, before potentially having another session scheduled.
  2. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  3. On the Notifications tab, manage your notifications:
  • Under System Notifications, edit your system notification type:
  • Click the Select notification type dropdown, then select from the following options:
  • Send calendar invitation: After booking a schedule, an event will be created in your calendar and your invitee will be added as an attendee. After selecting this option, under Calendar Invitation, you can click Edit to edit the Calendar Event Invitation.
  • Send email confirmation: After selecting this option, under Email Confirmation, you can click Edit to edit the Booking Confirmation Email or Cancellation Email.
  • (Optional) Select the Use a no-reply email address checkbox to hide your email address by having Zoom send email invites to attendees rather than from your own email address.
  • Under Additional Notifications, choose the SMS and email notifications you want to apply to this booking schedule. Click the toggle to enable or disable the following additional notifications:
  • Booking Confirmation SMS: Sent immediately after a user books.
  • Cancellation SMS: Sent immediately after a user cancels.
  • Reconfirmation Email & SMS: Sent 2 days before the scheduled date, this email is sent to reconfirm a scheduled event.
  • Reminder Email & SMS: Sent 1 day before the scheduled date, this email is sent to remind the person who scheduled the event.
  • Thank You Email & SMS: Sent 30 minutes after the event ends, this email is sent to thank the person for attending.
  • Quick Survey Email & SMS: Sent 1 hour after the event ends, this email is sent to have the participant(s) who scheduled the event to respond to a survey.
  • Follow Up Email & SMS: Sent 1 day after the event ends, this email is sent to follow up with the person who scheduled the event.
  • Additional Resources Email & SMS: Sent immediately after the event ends, this email is sent to share additional resources with the participant(s).
  • Any custom email notifications will be displayed at the bottom of the list.
  • (Optional) Under Cancellation Policy, use this optional setting to add a cancellation policy for your event. The text entered will appear in the email notification sent to your invitee.
  • (Optional) Select the Include cancel and reschedule links in notifications checkbox.
  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. On the More Options tab, choose from the following additional configuration options:
  • Show schedules in increments of: Choose how frequent time slots in a given time range are generated. Time slots will overlap each other until a session is booked, then conflicting time slots will be removed.
  • Maximum schedules per day for attendees: Choose to limit how many sessions are allowed per day.
  • Set minimum time before a schedule starts that attendees can book: Choose the minimum time before a bookable schedule starts that attendees can book. Enter the number, then select days,hours, or minutes from the dropdown menu.
  • Set maximum advance time for attendees to book: Select the amount of time that can be booked ahead of time. Enter the number of days, then select days or weekdays from the dropdown menu to set the number of days that can be booked ahead of time.
  • Require verification code to book: Select this checkbox to require users booking an appointment to enter a verification code sent to the email address used to schedule the meeting.
  • Attendee Questions: Create custom fields in Q&A format. You can enable or disable the field, set the field as Required, choose to show the field on the scheduling page, and choose the Answer Format, and delete or add more fields.
  • Confirmation Page: Customize your booking schedule confirmation page. You can also add a URL on your confirmation page to redirect attendees to another website with additional information.
  • Upon Confirmation: Click the dropdown and select if you want to Display Zoom Scheduler confirmation page or Redirect to external site for attendees.
  • (Optional) Click the Display button text to schedule another event checkbox. Then, enter the Button text.
  1. Click Finish to save this bookable schedule. When created, you will be provided with the link to this booking calendar, so that it can be shared with others.
  • (Optional) Under the booking link, select the Generate single-use link checkbox. When selected, this single-use link will expire after an attendee books an event using this link. Unused links will appear as pending in your Booked Schedules tab.

Scheduling an appointment on Zoom Scheduler

Category: Getting started and setting up > User guide

How to schedule an appointment with someone’s booking link

  1. Open the link provided by the host.
  2. If you are viewing their booking profile, choose one of the available booking schedules. Depending on the host’s preferences, these will typically have different names, durations, or other customizations. At the top of the page, the name of the bookable event, duration, description, conferencing option, and how many attendees are allowed is displayed.
  3. On the left side, use the calendar to choose a specific date you want to view availability. That date and the entire upcoming week’s worth of availability are displayed to the right. Notes:
  • Based on the host’s preferences for this booking schedule, some dates may not have any availability. Choose another date or reach out to the host directly to ask for alternate availability.
  • If you are in a different time zone from the organizer, you can search for and select the time zone that matches your current geographic location.
  1. Review the available time slots for the week chosen.
  2. Click a time slot to book that session.
  3. Review the details for this time slot, then provide the following information:
  • First Name: The first name you are booking this time slot with.
  • Last Name: The last name you are booking this time slot with.
  • Email Address: This is the email address you are booking the time slot with. Email verification codes, confirmation emails, and any other emails the host chooses to send will be sent to this email address.
  • (Optional) Add Attendees : Add attendee emails when you book/schedule an appointment, separating them with commas, spaces, or by pressing Enter. To the right of an attendee email you want to remove, click X. You can also paste a list of guest emails. The added guests can reschedule, decline, or delete an appointment. Notes:
  • You can add up to 100 attendees.
  • If guests are added, SMS updates are not supported.
  • (Optional) Select the Send me updates for this event by SMS checkbox to receive notifications by text message.
  • Select your Country Code.
  • Enter your Phone Number.
  • (Optional) Share anything that will help prepare for the meeting.
  1. Click Book to confirm the appointment.

Adding attendees to a Zoom Scheduler appointment

Category: Product features > User features

How to manage Zoom Scheduler appointments as an attendee

Add attendees when scheduling an appointment

Note: Attendee phone numbers may be visible to hosts.

  1. Open the link provided by the host.
  2. If you are viewing their booking profile, choose one of the available booking schedules. These will typically have different names, durations, or other customizations based on the host’s preferences. At the top of the page, the name of the bookable event, duration, description, conferencing option, and how many attendees are allowed is displayed.
  3. On the left side, use the calendar to choose a specific date you want to view availability. That date and the entire upcoming week’s worth of availability are displayed to the right. Notes:
  • Based on the host’s preferences for this booking schedule, some dates may not have any availability. Choose another date or reach out to the host directly to ask for alternate availability.
  • If you are in a different time zone from the organizer, you can search for and select the time zone that matches your current geographic location.
  1. Review the available time slots for the week chosen.
  2. Click a time slot to book that session.
  3. Review the details for this time slot, then follow the booking process and provide your contact information.
  4. Click Add Attendees to add attendee emails, separating them with commas and spaces, or by pressing Enter. You can also paste a list of guest emails. Notes:
  • You can add up to 100 attendees.
  • If guests are added, SMS updates are not supported.
  1. (Optional) To the right of an attendee email you want to remove, click X.
  2. (Optional) Share anything that will help prepare for the meeting.
  3. Click Book to confirm the appointment. After scheduling an appointment, the scheduling confirmation screen will list Additional Guest emails who are added through Zoom Scheduler.

An extra row of Additional Guests will be added to the confirmation email. The confirmation email will list all the invited guest emails and only guests who are added through Zoom Scheduler; guests added through the calendar directly will not be listed.

All emails going to attendees will also be delivered to the guests who are added through Zoom Scheduler.

A calendar invite will be delivered to the host, attendees, and guests through email.

How to manage Zoom Scheduler appointments as a guest

Reschedule an appointment as a guest

Guests can re-schedule the appointment just like an attendee. Guests can only edit (add and remove) other guests but not the attendee (the person who booked the schedule). Guests also cannot edit questions.

  1. Click the calendar invite or email link of the appointment. In the email invitation, you can also click Reschedule. This link will direct you to the rescheduling page.
  2. Complete the following actions:
  • Select a new time.
  • Select the same time and add guests.
  1. Schedule and book the appointment.

All attendees, guests, and hosts will receive an updated email that states the new time and old time. All attendees, guests, and hosts will receive an updated calendar invite (through email) stating the new time.

The scheduling confirmation screen will reflect the updated event time for event organizers.

Decline an appointment as a guest

When you receive the appointment invitation email or access the calendar invitation, click No to decline the appointment.

No updates will be sent to the attendees, guests, and hosts.

Delete an appointment as a guest
  1. Click the calendar invite or email link of the appointment. This link will direct you to the appointment details page.
  2. On the page, click the trash icon to delete the event.

No updates will be sent to the attendees, guests, and hosts.

Connecting Zoom Scheduler to your calendar service

Category: Settings and Configuration > User settings and configuration > Zoom web portal

Automatic calendar connection (auto-sync)

Scheduler automatically connects the calendar you’ve linked to your Zoom Workplace profile or through the Zoom Calendar app, no need to connect it again separately in Scheduler. Auto-sync is triggered when you add a calendar to your Zoom profile. Once connected there, Scheduler will use that connection automatically.

Auto-sync supports the following calendar services:

  • Google Calendar
  • Microsoft 365

For full Scheduler functionality (reading availability and creating/updating events), grant both read and write permissions when connecting your calendar to Zoom.

Note: You can still connect additional calendars manually in Scheduler settings, auto-sync doesn’t replace that option.

How to access the Accounts tab in Zoom Scheduler settings

  1. Sign in to your Zoom account on the Zoom web portal.
  2. In the left navigation menu, click Scheduler.
  3. In the top-right corner, click Settings.
  4. Click the Accounts tab. Your connected accounts will be displayed.

How to connect Zoom Scheduler to your calendar service

Connect Zoom Scheduler to your Google Calendar
  1. Open Zoom Scheduler through the web portal. Upon opening for the first time, you will be prompted to connect to a calendar service.
  2. Click Sign in with Google. You will be prompted to choose the Google account you want to connect with or sign in to your Google account.
  3. Choose the account you want to use, or sign in to another account.
  4. Review the permissions requested for the Zoom Scheduler connection to your account.
  5. Click Allow to grant access to your Google account. Once the connection is complete, you will be able to start configuring your booking schedules.
Connect Zoom Scheduler to your Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com calendar services
  1. Open Zoom Scheduler through the web portal. Upon opening for the first time, you will be prompted to connect to a calendar service.
  2. Click Sign in with Microsoft to allow access to your Office 365 account. You will be directed to the Office 365 sign-in page.
  3. Sign in to your Office 365 account.
  4. Review the permissions requested for the Zoom Scheduler connection to your account.
  5. Click Allow to grant access to your Outlook account. Once the connection is complete, you will be able to start configuring your booking schedules.

Note: If you have initially connected Zoom Scheduler to your calendar service but it has stopped working, you may need to reauthorize Zoom Scheduler to continue using it.

Connect Zoom Scheduler to Zoom Mail Service
  1. Open Zoom Scheduler through the web portal. Upon opening for the first time, you will be prompted to connect to a calendar service.
  2. Complete the following actions:
  • If you’ve never created a Zoom Mail account, Click Create Zoom Mail to get started. You will be guided through the process of creating your Zoom Mail email address.
  • If you’ve already created a Zoom Mail account, Zoom Scheduler will be automatically connected to that calendar.
  1. Once the connection is complete, start configuring your booking schedules.

How to manage calendar accounts

If you need to disconnect a calendar service or switch to a different calendar account, you can do this through Scheduler settings.

  1. Access the Accounts tab in Zoom Scheduler settings.
  2. Choose from the following options:
  • Click Add another account to connect another calendar service. The same steps as above should be followed, depending on the service chosen. Note: You can sync more than 1 account to their Zoom Scheduler account. When creating events, they can select which account they want the event to belong to.
  • To the right of a connected calendar service, click the ellipsis icon to view more options:
  • Click Reauthorize to reconnect to the selected calendar service. This can be useful when troubleshooting connection issues between Zoom Scheduler and your calendar service.
  • Click Edit Cancellation Preference to set your cancellation preference.
  • Click Edit Availability Preference to include or exclude different event types when generating availability. Note: This currently applies only to Office 365 accounts.
  • Click Disconnect to remove this calendar service from Zoom Scheduler.
Manage cancellation preferences

Zoom Scheduler syncs with an organizer’s calendar, detecting when an appointment is canceled outside of the Zoom Scheduler platform. When a user cancels an appointment in their calendaring application, Zoom Scheduler will remove the appointment from the Scheduled tab and a cancellation email will be sent.

  1. Access the Accounts tab in Zoom Scheduler settings.
  2. Access the connected calendar account that you want to manage.
  3. To the right of that connected calendar account, click the ellipsis , then click Edit Cancellation Preference. A pop-up window will appear.
  4. In the window, select or deselect the following checkbox: When an event is deleted or declined in your calendar, it will be automatically canceled in Zoom Scheduler.
  5. Click Save. Your cancellation preference will be saved.
Manage availability preferences

Users can decide to include or exclude different event types when generating availability. Users can set whether Zoom Scheduler assumes the different event types are Busy (i.e., Accepted Events, Declined Events, Out of Office, etc.).

Note: This currently applies only to Office 365 accounts.

  1. Access the connected calendar account that you want to manage.
  2. To the right of that connected calendar account, click the ellipsis .
  3. Click Edit Availability Preference, then click Configure conflict check. A pop-up window will appear.
  4. In the window, select the event types you want to check for conflicts to prevent double bookings.
  5. Click Save. Your availability preferences will be updated. Within the bookable schedule creation page, you can set whether they would like Zoom Scheduler to assume the selected event types are “Busy.”

How to set a different account as primary

Users can sync more than 1 account to their Zoom Scheduler account. When creating events, they can select which account they want the event to belong to.

  1. Connect Zoom Scheduler to your calendar service and add more than 1 account.
  2. Access the Accounts tab in Zoom Scheduler settings.
  3. Under Connected Accounts, hover your mouse over the account you want to make primary, then click Set as Primary. A pop-up window will appear, notifying you that you have multiple calendars under your account.
  4. In the window, select a calendar, then click Set as Primary. The account will appear with a checkmark icon in the Accounts tab. All schedules will be made to your selected primary calendar.
Edit primary account settings
  1. Access the Accounts tab in Zoom Scheduler settings.
  2. Under Connected Accounts, hover your mouse over the account you want to edit, then click Primary Account Settings. A pop-up window will appear.
  3. In the window, edit the following settings:
  • Under Select a Calendar, select the primary calendar you want your scheduled events to be written to.
  • (Optional) Under Sync Cancellations, select or deselect the Cancel Zoom Scheduler events if deleted/declined in calendar checkbox.
  1. Click Save Changes.

How to check for schedule conflicts

Customize which calendars you want to check for schedule conflicts.

  1. Access the Accounts tab in Zoom Scheduler settings.
  2. Under Check for Conflicts, to the right of the calendar you want to manage, click the toggle to enable or disable it. When enabled, the calendar will be checked for scheduled conflicts. When disabled, the calendar will not be checked for scheduled conflicts.
  3. After enabling the toggle, hover your mouse over the email account you want to manage, then click Edit. A pop-up window will appear.
  4. In the pop-up window, select the checkboxes of the subscribed calendars you want to check for conflicts to prevent double bookings.
  5. Click Save.

Managing and customizing Zoom Scheduler email notifications

Category: Settings and Configuration > User settings and configuration > Zoom web portal

How to access email notifications

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web

  1. Sign in to the Zoom desktop app.

  2. Click More , then click the Scheduler tab .

  3. In the navigation menu, click the Notification Settings tab.

  4. Sign in to the Zoom web portal.

  5. In the left navigation menu, click Scheduler.

  6. Click the Notifications tab.

How to edit email notifications

Customize the email and SMS notifications being sent to you or attendees. The following email notifications can be edited and customized.

Note: Your phone number is needed for SMS notifications to work. You will receive a message if you haven’t added your phone number. In the message, click Set phone number.

Booking confirmation email

The booking confirmation email is sent to both you and the person booking the session with you. This is sent immediately after the booking is confirmed. If requiring a verification code, the confirmation email is sent after the user enters the confirmation code sent to them by email.

The host can edit the email template and its settings.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
  • Apply to all new repeating booking schedules: Select the checkbox to have these customizations applied to any new booking schedules you create.
  • Email timing : Set how many days, hours, or minutes before the event starts when the reconfirmation email is sent.
  • Send Email : Choose who to send the reconfirmation email: To you (the host), To attendee, or To you and attendee.
  • Depending on the selection made above, the option to edit and preview the Email to Attendees and/or the Email to You will be shown below. On the bottom-right corner of the email preview, click Edit to customize the email template.
  • Click Save Changes to save the edits.
Reschedule email

The booking confirmation email is sent to both you and the person rescheduling the session with you. This is sent immediately after the booking is confirmed. If requiring a verification code, the confirmation email is sent after the user enters the confirmation code sent to them by email.

The host cannot edit this email template and its settings.

Cancellation email

The booking cancellation email is sent to both you and the person that booked the session with you. This is sent immediately after the booking is canceled, either by the host or the person that booked the session.

The host can edit the email template and its settings.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
  • Apply to all new repeating booking schedules: Select the checkbox to have these customizations applied to any new booking schedules you create.
  • Email timing : Set how many days, hours, or minutes before the event starts when the reconfirmation email is sent.
  • Send Email : Choose who to send the reconfirmation email: To you (the host), To attendee, or To you and attendee.
  • Depending on the selection made above, the option to edit and preview the Email to Attendees and/or the Email to You will be shown below. On the bottom-right corner of the email preview, click Edit to customize the email template.
  • Click Save Changes to save the edits.
Reconfirmation email

The reconfirmation email is sent to remind and confirm that the booked session is still taking place at the scheduled date and time.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
  • Apply to all new repeating booking schedules: Select the checkbox to have these customizations applied to any new booking schedules you create.
  • Email timing : Set how many days, hours, or minutes before the event starts when the reconfirmation email is sent.
  • Send Email : Choose who to send the reconfirmation email: To you (the host), To attendee, or To you and attendee.
  • Depending on the selection made above, the option to edit and preview the Email to Attendees and/or the Email to You will be shown below. On the bottom-right corner of the email preview, click Edit to customize the email template.
  • Click Save Changes to save the edits.
Reminder email

The reminder email is sent to remind the host and attendees of the booked session at the scheduled date and time.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
  • Apply to all new repeating booking schedules: Select the checkbox to have these customizations applied to any new booking schedules you create.
  • Email timing : Set how many days, hours, or minutes before the event starts when the reminder email is sent.
  • Send Email : Choose who to send the reminder email: To you (the host), To attendee, or To you and attendee.
  • Depending on the selection made above, the option to edit and preview the Email to Attendees and/or the Email to You will be shown below. On the bottom-right corner of the email preview, click Edit to customize the email template.
  • Click Save Changes to save the edits.
Follow up email

The follow-up email is sent after the end of the session to follow up with the host and/or attendees of the booked session. By default, the follow-up email thanks them for their attendance, encourages them to schedule another session, and requests feedback or questions.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
  • Apply to all new repeating booking schedules: Select the checkbox to have these customizations applied to any new booking schedules you create.
  • Email timing : Set how many days, hours, or minutes after the event ends when the follow up email is sent.
  • Send Email : Choose who to send the follow-up email: To you (the host), To attendee, or To you and attendee.
  • Depending on the selection made above, the option to edit and preview the Email to Attendees and/or the Email to You will be shown below. On the bottom-right corner of the email preview, click Edit to customize the email template.
  • Click Save Changes to save the edits.
Quick survey email

The quick survey email is sent after the end of the session to encourage attendees to respond to a survey about the booked session. The host must provide the link(s) to the survey (created by the host) and request feedback or questions.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
  • Apply to all new repeating booking schedules: Select the checkbox to have these customizations applied to any new booking schedules you create.
  • Email timing : Set how many days, hours, or minutes after the event ends when the quick survey email is sent.

Thank you email

The thank you email is sent after the end of the session to encourage attendees to respond to a survey about the booked session. By default, the follow-up email thanks them for their attendance and encourages any feedback or questions.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
  • Apply to all new repeating booking schedules: Select the checkbox to have these customizations applied to any new booking schedules you create.
  • Email timing : Set how many days, hours, or minutes after the event ends when the thank you email is sent.

  • Click Save Changes to save the edits.
Additional resources email

The additional resources email is sent after the end of the session to provide attendees with links to additional resources related to the booked session. Links to the additional resources must be provided by the host.

  • Applied to : Choose which existing booking schedules these customizations will apply to. Unselected booking schedules will use the default settings, if this email notification is enabled for that booking schedule.
